items.headline: Jahiem Lawson returns fumble 22 yards for a score, Clemson holds on to defeat Syracuse 18-13
items.description: — Jahiem Lawson returned Syracuse quarterback Steve Angeli’s backwards pass and fumble 22 yards for a score, Ashton Hampton intercepted Angeli in the end zone and Clemson held on to defeat the Orange 18-13 Saturday.
